known.title: Not done: A failed full run opens a fix that names the failing tests.
Initialize origin/HEAD before running the full suite in Actions

findings.body:
Gain 5, Work 3, Harm 3
Raise: Not done. Case: normal use - a nightly pytest run fails, or a full run started through workflow_dispatch fails. The CI failure path has two gaps. First, review.test_run injects `-rs` (src/forge/review.py:473), which selects skipped-test summaries rather than FAILED/ERROR summaries ([pytest reporting contract](https://docs.pytest.org/en/stable/_modules/_pytest/terminal.html)). Its explicit failure list uses `- <nodeid>` bullets (:540), but board_facts.failed_schedules recognizes only `FAILED|ERROR <nodeid>` (src/forge/board_facts.py:216). Consequently, ordinary nightly pytest failures produce a fix report without the failing test names. The proof at tests/test_testplace_fullrun.py:330 supplies manufactured uppercase summaries instead of this command's output. Second, fullrun.py:72 suppresses the fix command in CI mode, while board_facts.py:193 queries only `event=schedule`; failed on-demand runs therefore produce no fix command at all. Both CI entry paths need reporting that preserves the real failing IDs.

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional. Case: normal use - an existing CI client whose default branch is master upgrades and receives this job. The checkout uses explicit fetch refspecs ([checkout implementation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/actions/checkout/v7/src/git-command-manager.ts)); Git creates origin/HEAD automatically only when fetching with default refspecs ([Git contract](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-config#Documentation/git-config.txt-fetchfollowRemoteHEAD)). This job never initializes that symbolic ref. src/forge/repo.py:413-415 consequently identifies the default branch as main, and fullrun.latest fetches refs/heads/main instead of master. The nightly and on-demand jobs fail before testing or publishing a status, leaving the new release and sign-off gates blocked. Initialize the remote default-branch reference before invoking Forge.
findings.title: Initialize origin/HEAD before running the full suite in Actions

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 3, Harm 3
Raise: Test. Case: normal use - another developer advances remote main after this checkout last fetched, leaving a green status on the cached commit and no green run on current main. Every gate scenario uses an already-current local origin/main; the older-tag case merely tags its ancestor. Removing the fetch from fullrun.latest would leave this proof passing while both release and sign-off gates could authorize the cached green commit. Add a command-level case that advances main independently, retains success on the old commit, and verifies that the gates inspect and refuse the new remote commit.
